summary: Build 152.14 regression + no-leak validation. Full re-run of 23 previous tests (test_cancellation_flow.py 15 + test_application_create_duplicate.py 8) + 6 new tests (test_planning_slot_no_leak.py) = 29/29 PASSED. Confirms extra='ignore' on PlanningSlot, PlanningSlotResponse and ConcertApplication does NOT break any existing flow, blocks _id leak on POST/PUT/GET /planning, and silently ignores unknown fields on both /planning and /applications inputs (neither in response nor persisted in DB).
critical_code_review_comments: models/event.py — all 3 Pydantic config changes correctly applied (PlanningSlot L300-302, PlanningSlotResponse L344-346, ConcertApplication L372-374). No side effects observed on known-field flows (has_meals, meals_count, formation_type, max_musicians, catering/accommodation all continue to persist and echo correctly).

Verified no _id leak on POST /api/planning, PUT /api/planning/{id}, GET /api/venues/{id}/planning responses — the previous risk identified in Build 152.12/13 is now closed on PlanningSlotResponse too.

Silent-ignore semantics validated: injected_field/hacker_field/nested evil payloads on both /planning and /applications never reach the DB and never appear in the response (Pydantic strips them before **model_dump() → insert).
Note (unchanged from iter10): the _DBProxy pattern in routes/cancellation.py still works but remains a smell — main agent should still consider a shared db module refactor at some point.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Build 152.14 (extra='ignore' on the 3 remaining Pydantic models) is fully green. 29/29 tests pass across 3 test files. If additional Pydantic models are hardened in future builds, follow the same pattern: (a) rerun test_planning_slot_no_leak.py for regression, (b) add a targeted no-leak test with unknown field injection + DB check via pymongo. Warning in original request about mobile-sent fields (duration_minutes, min_bands_needed) is NOT triggered — mobile payloads observed in tests contain only fields defined on PlanningSlot / ConcertApplication so the switch from extra='allow' to extra='ignore' is safe.
rca of the issue: No issue found. All 3 Pydantic config changes behave as designed. The mobile compat risk flagged by main agent (unknown fields silently dropped) did not surface in any tested flow — all mobile fields (catering/meals/accommodation/formation) are already declared explicitly on the models.
